summary: Charming Medical Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release disclosing a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff delisting determination letter dated October 29, 2026, issued under Listing Rule IM-5101-4 following the SEC's November 11, 2025 trading-suspension order tied to suspected social-media manipulation. No price, stake, or premium terms apply. Unless the Company appeals by November 5, 2026, trading suspends at the open on November 9, 2026, and Nasdaq will file a Form 25-NSE to remove listing and registration. The Company says it is consulting counsel and evaluating next steps; Nasdaq has made no finding of wrongdoing, and operations are unaffected. Watch for an appeal, OTC quotation prospects, and liquidity risk.
